'''2019 Worlds Day 2 Mike Klarenbeek LS Hunt For The Droid General''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Klarenbeek]] at [[2019 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Klarenbeek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (location)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Hunt For The Droid General Klarenbe.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127130309/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ Internet Archive]
